title: Entity search
responsibility: Opens project search from a navbar icon and finds entities in the selected revision.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.entries
inputs.description: Required list of entities, or null while the host loads them. Null yields no matches and loading wording; the component does not fetch entries.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.scope
inputs.description: Required label and optional pinned commit. Label names searched scope; pinned takes precedence in placeholder wording over loading.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.href
inputs.description: Required callback providing complete result link targets.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.open
inputs.description: Opens the chosen entity in the host after closing the search modal.

outputs.name: EntitySearch
outputs.description: A search icon opens a modal by click or Cmd/Ctrl+K. The focused query offers ranked results; arrows and Enter navigate. Escape closes the modal and restores icon focus.
